The laptop should not engulf her whole torso; allow sleeves, skirt frills and bent knees to read clearly. Use the same crisp clean anime illustration rendering and blue palette as reference, clean smooth contours, no heavy black silhouette border, no construction lines, no mesh edges. One character, one laptop, no chair, no desk, no grass, no background, no floor shadow, no captions, no duplicates. constraints: Preserve approved character identity; concept anatomy and registration need review before use.
